## 可参考 SkillBank
以下是该角色从既往训练轨迹中获得的可参考经验。它们不是环境事实，不改变当前角色职责、输出格式、任务目标或环境动作规则。
- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | G_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
principle: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty.
[General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
principle: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
when_to_apply: When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held.
[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]
description: Do not declare completion or stop based on an attempted action alone. After critical actions such as take, put, clean, heat, or cool, inspect the observation for the goal predicate. Declare success only when the observation confirms the required final state; declare failure only when the observation shows an invalid or blocked action, an unreachable object, or exhaustion of plausible locations. If the placement observation already confirms the goal, treat it as terminal and do not run a redundant verification step.
why_it_happens: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
how_to_avoid: After each critical action, compare the observation with the expected state. If the action failed, retry only after adjusting the approach; if it succeeded, stop issuing extra actions. Treat a confirming placement, cleaning, heating, or cooling observation as the terminal success condition. Do not declare completion before the final placement is confirmed; after confirmation, stop and do not send empty or inventory-only actions.

[General | G_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
principle: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty.
[General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
principle: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
when_to_apply: When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held.
[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]
description: Do not declare completion or stop based on an attempted action alone. After critical actions such as take, put, clean, heat, or cool, inspect the observation for the goal predicate. Declare success only when the observation confirms the required final state; declare failure only when the observation shows an invalid or blocked action, an unreachable object, or exhaustion of plausible locations. If the placement observation already confirms the goal, treat it as terminal and do not run a redundant verification step.
why_it_happens: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
how_to_avoid: After each critical action, compare the observation with the expected state. If the action failed, retry only after adjusting the approach; if it succeeded, stop issuing extra actions. Treat a confirming placement, cleaning, heating, or cooling observation as the terminal success condition. Do not declare completion before the final placement is confirmed; after confirmation, stop and do not send empty or inventory-only actions.

title: 先加热后放置的端到端流程

[General | G_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
principle: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty.
[General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
principle: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
when_to_apply: When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held.
[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]
description: Do not declare completion or stop based on an attempted action alone. After critical actions such as take, put, clean, heat, or cool, inspect the observation for the goal predicate. Declare success only when the observation confirms the required final state; declare failure only when the observation shows an invalid or blocked action, an unreachable object, or exhaustion of plausible locations. If the placement observation already confirms the goal, treat it as terminal and do not run a redundant verification step.
why_it_happens: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
how_to_avoid: After each critical action, compare the observation with the expected state. If the action failed, retry only after adjusting the approach; if it succeeded, stop issuing extra actions. Treat a confirming placement, cleaning, heating, or cooling observation as the terminal success condition. Do not declare completion before the final placement is confirmed; after confirmation, stop and do not send empty or inventory-only actions.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 先加热后放置的端到端流程
principle: 对于先加热后放置的目标：定位并拿取目标物体，前往微波炉，若关闭则打开，用观察确认可行的方式完成加热，并持续跟踪同一物体实例；随后前往最终目的地，必要时打开容器，将物体放入并确认放置。加热只是中间里程碑，只有物体已在目的地放置后才算完成。若拿取后物体已在手中，应直接进入加热阶段，不必无谓重启。加热后，若物体确实被放入过微波炉，则从中取出；若加热是在手持状态下完成的，则保持手持并直接前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 任何要求先将物体加热、再放置到指定目的地的任务。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 微波加热的显式命令与位置切换恢复
principle: 使用微波炉前先打开，并通过观察确认其已打开。使用明确指定物体与微波炉的加热形式，例如 heat <object> with microwave <id>；裸用 use <object> 或 use microwave 等通用形式可能返回 Nothing happens。观测显示加热时物体可被手持，也可被放入打开的微波炉中，因此手持/放入要求应按观察条件处理。若手持加热返回 Nothing happens，可将物体放入打开的微波炉后重试；若物体在微波炉内加热失败，则取出物体、确认微波炉打开后改为手持重试。首次失败后应改变物体位置或手持状态，不要重复完全相同的失败命令；若切换后仍无确认，再切回另一状态重试一次。只有在观察到明确加热成功后，才继续前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 目标物体需要用微波炉加热时，尤其是首次加热尝试失败或物体位于微波炉内时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。
why_it_happens: 只有当物体位置与微波炉状态合适时，加热才可能改变状态；命令已发出并不保证成功。缺少明确成功观测时，后续移动和放置可能基于错误前提。
how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。
why_it_happens: 某些电器可能不支持加热目标物体，某些表面可能被占用，而且某个替代电器存在并不保证它支持该物体。若没有确认热状态就认可放置，即使发出了动作，任务仍可能失败。
how_to_avoid: 先修正微波炉交互：检查是否打开，调整物体是手持还是放入其中，并在不重复完全相同失败命令的情况下重试。只有在当前观察明确显示某替代电器支持加热该物体且可用时，才使用其他电器；否则不要把炉灶或烤面包机当作盲目后备。不要把普通放置或无加热动作当作已确认热状态的替代。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。
when_to_apply: 在先加热后放置任务的获取阶段，目标物体未立即出现或不在首个检查位置时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。
why_it_happens: 手持状态下的加热成功并不一定移动物体进入微波炉，因此微波炉里没有可取的该物体。若按错误位置假设继续操作，就会产生无效取物步骤。
how_to_avoid: 在手持加热成功后，通过库存或手持状态确认物体仍在手中，然后前往目的地。除非物体确实被放入过微波炉，否则不要发出从微波炉取物的动作。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。

Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. [General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions

[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]

[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 先加热后放置的端到端流程
principle: 对于先加热后放置的目标：定位并拿取目标物体，前往微波炉，若关闭则打开，用观察确认可行的方式完成加热，并持续跟踪同一物体实例；随后前往最终目的地，必要时打开容器，将物体放入并确认放置。加热只是中间里程碑，只有物体已在目的地放置后才算完成。若拿取后物体已在手中，应直接进入加热阶段，不必无谓重启。加热后，若物体确实被放入过微波炉，则从中取出；若加热是在手持状态下完成的，则保持手持并直接前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 任何要求先将物体加热、再放置到指定目的地的任务。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 微波加热的显式命令与位置切换恢复
principle: 使用微波炉前先打开，并通过观察确认其已打开。使用明确指定物体与微波炉的加热形式，例如 heat <object> with microwave <id>；裸用 use <object> 或 use microwave 等通用形式可能返回 Nothing happens。观测显示加热时物体可被手持，也可被放入打开的微波炉中，因此手持/放入要求应按观察条件处理。若手持加热返回 Nothing happens，可将物体放入打开的微波炉后重试；若物体在微波炉内加热失败，则取出物体、确认微波炉打开后改为手持重试。首次失败后应改变物体位置或手持状态，不要重复完全相同的失败命令；若切换后仍无确认，再切回另一状态重试一次。只有在观察到明确加热成功后，才继续前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 目标物体需要用微波炉加热时，尤其是首次加热尝试失败或物体位于微波炉内时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。
why_it_happens: 只有当物体位置与微波炉状态合适时，加热才可能改变状态；命令已发出并不保证成功。缺少明确成功观测时，后续移动和放置可能基于错误前提。
how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。
why_it_happens: 某些电器可能不支持加热目标物体，某些表面可能被占用，而且某个替代电器存在并不保证它支持该物体。若没有确认热状态就认可放置，即使发出了动作，任务仍可能失败。
how_to_avoid: 先修正微波炉交互：检查是否打开，调整物体是手持还是放入其中，并在不重复完全相同失败命令的情况下重试。只有在当前观察明确显示某替代电器支持加热该物体且可用时，才使用其他电器；否则不要把炉灶或烤面包机当作盲目后备。不要把普通放置或无加热动作当作已确认热状态的替代。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。
when_to_apply: 在先加热后放置任务的获取阶段，目标物体未立即出现或不在首个检查位置时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。
why_it_happens: 手持状态下的加热成功并不一定移动物体进入微波炉，因此微波炉里没有可取的该物体。若按错误位置假设继续操作，就会产生无效取物步骤。
how_to_avoid: 在手持加热成功后，通过库存或手持状态确认物体仍在手中，然后前往目的地。除非物体确实被放入过微波炉，否则不要发出从微波炉取物的动作。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。

title: 微波加热的显式命令与位置切换恢复
principle: 使用微波炉前先打开，并通过观察确认其已打开。使用明确指定物体与微波炉的加热形式，例如 heat <object> with microwave <id>；裸用 use <object> 或 use microwave 等通用形式可能返回 Nothing happens。观测显示加热时物体可被手持，也可被放入打开的微波炉中，因此手持/放入要求应按观察条件处理。若手持加热返回 Nothing happens，可将物体放入打开的微波炉后重试；若物体在微波炉内加热失败，则取出物体、确认微波炉打开后改为手持重试。首次失败后应改变物体位置或手持状态，不要重复完全相同的失败命令；若切换后仍无确认，再切回另一状态重试一次。只有在观察到明确加热成功后，才继续前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 目标物体需要用微波炉加热时，尤其是首次加热尝试失败或物体位于微波炉内时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。
why_it_happens: 只有当物体位置与微波炉状态合适时，加热才可能改变状态；命令已发出并不保证成功。缺少明确成功观测时，后续移动和放置可能基于错误前提。
how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。

[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。

[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。

[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。

[General | G_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
principle: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty.
[General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
principle: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
when_to_apply: When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held.
[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]
description: Do not declare completion or stop based on an attempted action alone. After critical actions such as take, put, clean, heat, or cool, inspect the observation for the goal predicate. Declare success only when the observation confirms the required final state; declare failure only when the observation shows an invalid or blocked action, an unreachable object, or exhaustion of plausible locations. If the placement observation already confirms the goal, treat it as terminal and do not run a redundant verification step.
why_it_happens: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
how_to_avoid: After each critical action, compare the observation with the expected state. If the action failed, retry only after adjusting the approach; if it succeeded, stop issuing extra actions. Treat a confirming placement, cleaning, heating, or cooling observation as the terminal success condition. Do not declare completion before the final placement is confirmed; after confirmation, stop and do not send empty or inventory-only actions.

title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers

description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability

title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put

when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances

[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. title: 先加热后放置的端到端流程
principle: 对于先加热后放置的目标：定位并拿取目标物体，前往微波炉，若关闭则打开，用观察确认可行的方式完成加热，并持续跟踪同一物体实例；随后前往最终目的地，必要时打开容器，将物体放入并确认放置。加热只是中间里程碑，只有物体已在目的地放置后才算完成。若拿取后物体已在手中，应直接进入加热阶段，不必无谓重启。加热后，若物体确实被放入过微波炉，则从中取出；若加热是在手持状态下完成的，则保持手持并直接前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 任何要求先将物体加热、再放置到指定目的地的任务。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 微波加热的显式命令与位置切换恢复

[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。

how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。

[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。
when_to_apply: 在先加热后放置任务的获取阶段，目标物体未立即出现或不在首个检查位置时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。
why_it_happens: 手持状态下的加热成功并不一定移动物体进入微波炉，因此微波炉里没有可取的该物体。若按错误位置假设继续操作，就会产生无效取物步骤。
how_to_avoid: 在手持加热成功后，通过库存或手持状态确认物体仍在手中，然后前往目的地。除非物体确实被放入过微波炉，否则不要发出从微波炉取物的动作。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。

principle: 使用微波炉前先打开，并通过观察确认其已打开。使用明确指定物体与微波炉的加热形式，例如 heat <object> with microwave <id>；裸用 use <object> 或 use microwave 等通用形式可能返回 Nothing happens。观测显示加热时物体可被手持，也可被放入打开的微波炉中，因此手持/放入要求应按观察条件处理。若手持加热返回 Nothing happens，可将物体放入打开的微波炉后重试；若物体在微波炉内加热失败，则取出物体、确认微波炉打开后改为手持重试。首次失败后应改变物体位置或手持状态，不要重复完全相同的失败命令；若切换后仍无确认，再切回另一状态重试一次。只有在观察到明确加热成功后，才继续前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 目标物体需要用微波炉加热时，尤其是首次加热尝试失败或物体位于微波炉内时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。
why_it_happens: 只有当物体位置与微波炉状态合适时，加热才可能改变状态；命令已发出并不保证成功。缺少明确成功观测时，后续移动和放置可能基于错误前提。
how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。
why_it_happens: 某些电器可能不支持加热目标物体，某些表面可能被占用，而且某个替代电器存在并不保证它支持该物体。若没有确认热状态就认可放置，即使发出了动作，任务仍可能失败。
how_to_avoid: 先修正微波炉交互：检查是否打开，调整物体是手持还是放入其中，并在不重复完全相同失败命令的情况下重试。只有在当前观察明确显示某替代电器支持加热该物体且可用时，才使用其他电器；否则不要把炉灶或烤面包机当作盲目后备。不要把普通放置或无加热动作当作已确认热状态的替代。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。
when_to_apply: 在先加热后放置任务的获取阶段，目标物体未立即出现或不在首个检查位置时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。
why_it_happens: 手持状态下的加热成功并不一定移动物体进入微波炉，因此微波炉里没有可取的该物体。若按错误位置假设继续操作，就会产生无效取物步骤。
how_to_avoid: 在手持加热成功后，通过库存或手持状态确认物体仍在手中，然后前往目的地。除非物体确实被放入过微波炉，否则不要发出从微波炉取物的动作。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。

[General | G_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
principle: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty.
[General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
principle: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
when_to_apply: When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held.
[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]
description: Do not declare completion or stop based on an attempted action alone. After critical actions such as take, put, clean, heat, or cool, inspect the observation for the goal predicate. Declare success only when the observation confirms the required final state; declare failure only when the observation shows an invalid or blocked action, an unreachable object, or exhaustion of plausible locations. If the placement observation already confirms the goal, treat it as terminal and do not run a redundant verification step.
why_it_happens: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
how_to_avoid: After each critical action, compare the observation with the expected state. If the action failed, retry only after adjusting the approach; if it succeeded, stop issuing extra actions. Treat a confirming placement, cleaning, heating, or cooling observation as the terminal success condition. Do not declare completion before the final placement is confirmed; after confirmation, stop and do not send empty or inventory-only actions.

title: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
principle: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
when_to_apply: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
[General | G_002 | Failure Lesson]
description: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
why_it_happens: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
how_to_avoid: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
[General | G_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
principle: When a closed drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave, or similar container may hold the target or is the placement destination, navigate to it and open it before attempting to take from it or put into it. Closed containers cannot be inspected or used directly. Before placing, confirm the destination is already open or can be opened; if opening returns no change, treat it as non-openable and choose a valid open destination or surface. For non-openable fixtures, use only a go-then-put sequence.
when_to_apply: When the target may be inside a closed container, or when the placement destination is closed or its openability is uncertain.
[General | G_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
principle: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
when_to_apply: When retrieving an object whose location is not current, when moving a held object to a destination, or after a failed put.
[General | G_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
principle: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
when_to_apply: Throughout object search, retrieval, and placement, especially when forming commands or when an action seems unsupported or ambiguous.
[General | G_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
why_it_happens: The same invalid action may be retried without updating the inferred state, and a failed task segment may be reissued identically instead of changing the search location, object description, or strategy.
how_to_avoid: After a no-change observation, re-check location, inventory, exact identifiers, and object or container state. Change at least one relevant condition: move to a different reachable location, open a closed container, use the specific instance id, or switch to another strategy. After one or two identical failures, stop retrying. If a task segment fails or returns without meeting its condition, do not repeat it unchanged; broaden the search or change the approach. Before declaring blocked, ensure every plausible closed container was actually opened and inspected, not merely approached, and avoid revisiting surfaces already confirmed empty.
[General | G_007 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
principle: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
when_to_apply: When a goal requires an object to be acquired before it is used, transformed, or placed, and the object is not already held.
[General | G_008 | Failure Lesson]
description: Do not declare completion or stop based on an attempted action alone. After critical actions such as take, put, clean, heat, or cool, inspect the observation for the goal predicate. Declare success only when the observation confirms the required final state; declare failure only when the observation shows an invalid or blocked action, an unreachable object, or exhaustion of plausible locations. If the placement observation already confirms the goal, treat it as terminal and do not run a redundant verification step.
why_it_happens: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
how_to_avoid: After each critical action, compare the observation with the expected state. If the action failed, retry only after adjusting the approach; if it succeeded, stop issuing extra actions. Treat a confirming placement, cleaning, heating, or cooling observation as the terminal success condition. Do not declare completion before the final placement is confirmed; after confirmation, stop and do not send empty or inventory-only actions.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 先加热后放置的端到端流程
principle: 对于先加热后放置的目标：定位并拿取目标物体，前往微波炉，若关闭则打开，用观察确认可行的方式完成加热，并持续跟踪同一物体实例；随后前往最终目的地，必要时打开容器，将物体放入并确认放置。加热只是中间里程碑，只有物体已在目的地放置后才算完成。若拿取后物体已在手中，应直接进入加热阶段，不必无谓重启。加热后，若物体确实被放入过微波炉，则从中取出；若加热是在手持状态下完成的，则保持手持并直接前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 任何要求先将物体加热、再放置到指定目的地的任务。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 微波加热的显式命令与位置切换恢复
principle: 使用微波炉前先打开，并通过观察确认其已打开。使用明确指定物体与微波炉的加热形式，例如 heat <object> with microwave <id>；裸用 use <object> 或 use microwave 等通用形式可能返回 Nothing happens。观测显示加热时物体可被手持，也可被放入打开的微波炉中，因此手持/放入要求应按观察条件处理。若手持加热返回 Nothing happens，可将物体放入打开的微波炉后重试；若物体在微波炉内加热失败，则取出物体、确认微波炉打开后改为手持重试。首次失败后应改变物体位置或手持状态，不要重复完全相同的失败命令；若切换后仍无确认，再切回另一状态重试一次。只有在观察到明确加热成功后，才继续前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 目标物体需要用微波炉加热时，尤其是首次加热尝试失败或物体位于微波炉内时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。
why_it_happens: 只有当物体位置与微波炉状态合适时，加热才可能改变状态；命令已发出并不保证成功。缺少明确成功观测时，后续移动和放置可能基于错误前提。
how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。
why_it_happens: 某些电器可能不支持加热目标物体，某些表面可能被占用，而且某个替代电器存在并不保证它支持该物体。若没有确认热状态就认可放置，即使发出了动作，任务仍可能失败。
how_to_avoid: 先修正微波炉交互：检查是否打开，调整物体是手持还是放入其中，并在不重复完全相同失败命令的情况下重试。只有在当前观察明确显示某替代电器支持加热该物体且可用时，才使用其他电器；否则不要把炉灶或烤面包机当作盲目后备。不要把普通放置或无加热动作当作已确认热状态的替代。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。
when_to_apply: 在先加热后放置任务的获取阶段，目标物体未立即出现或不在首个检查位置时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。
why_it_happens: 手持状态下的加热成功并不一定移动物体进入微波炉，因此微波炉里没有可取的该物体。若按错误位置假设继续操作，就会产生无效取物步骤。
how_to_avoid: 在手持加热成功后，通过库存或手持状态确认物体仍在手中，然后前往目的地。除非物体确实被放入过微波炉，否则不要发出从微波炉取物的动作。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。

principle: 对于先加热后放置的目标：定位并拿取目标物体，前往微波炉，若关闭则打开，用观察确认可行的方式完成加热，并持续跟踪同一物体实例；随后前往最终目的地，必要时打开容器，将物体放入并确认放置。加热只是中间里程碑，只有物体已在目的地放置后才算完成。若拿取后物体已在手中，应直接进入加热阶段，不必无谓重启。加热后，若物体确实被放入过微波炉，则从中取出；若加热是在手持状态下完成的，则保持手持并直接前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 任何要求先将物体加热、再放置到指定目的地的任务。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 微波加热的显式命令与位置切换恢复
principle: 使用微波炉前先打开，并通过观察确认其已打开。使用明确指定物体与微波炉的加热形式，例如 heat <object> with microwave <id>；裸用 use <object> 或 use microwave 等通用形式可能返回 Nothing happens。观测显示加热时物体可被手持，也可被放入打开的微波炉中，因此手持/放入要求应按观察条件处理。若手持加热返回 Nothing happens，可将物体放入打开的微波炉后重试；若物体在微波炉内加热失败，则取出物体、确认微波炉打开后改为手持重试。首次失败后应改变物体位置或手持状态，不要重复完全相同的失败命令；若切换后仍无确认，再切回另一状态重试一次。只有在观察到明确加热成功后，才继续前往目的地。
when_to_apply: 目标物体需要用微波炉加热时，尤其是首次加热尝试失败或物体位于微波炉内时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_003 | Failure Lesson]
description: 加热命令可能失败或返回 Nothing happens；若把未确认的尝试当作成功，可能导致移动并放置一个仍然冷的物体。不能仅因物体被手持或被放入微波炉就推断加热成功。
why_it_happens: 只有当物体位置与微波炉状态合适时，加热才可能改变状态；命令已发出并不保证成功。缺少明确成功观测时，后续移动和放置可能基于错误前提。
how_to_avoid: 只有在出现明确的加热成功观测后才继续，例如提示物体已被加热，或其他可靠的热状态确认。若未确认成功，应修正物体位置或手持状态后重新执行有效加热尝试，并再次验证，然后再移动物体。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_004 | Failure Lesson]
description: 微波炉加热返回 Nothing happens 后，若无证据就改用炉灶、烤面包机或其他电器，也可能失败或被阻止；基于假设的替换只会增加失败步骤。接受未加热物体的放置，或以普通降温/无加热动作代替热状态目标，也不能满足任务要求。
why_it_happens: 某些电器可能不支持加热目标物体，某些表面可能被占用，而且某个替代电器存在并不保证它支持该物体。若没有确认热状态就认可放置，即使发出了动作，任务仍可能失败。
how_to_avoid: 先修正微波炉交互：检查是否打开，调整物体是手持还是放入其中，并在不重复完全相同失败命令的情况下重试。只有在当前观察明确显示某替代电器支持加热该物体且可用时，才使用其他电器；否则不要把炉灶或烤面包机当作盲目后备。不要把普通放置或无加热动作当作已确认热状态的替代。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: 目标缺失时的系统搜索
principle: 当目标物体不在首个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能容器和表面，例如橱柜、抽屉、台面、餐桌、炉灶、冰箱、水槽盆、咖啡机、边桌等。维护已检查位置记录，优先转向尚未检查且已打开的容器和可见表面，避免重复回到已确认空的位置。不要仅因首个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不存在。若连续几个容器为空，应扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是无限逐抽屉搜索；对盘碟类物体可优先查看餐桌、台面和边桌等开放表面，同时兼顾容器。经过合理范围的广泛搜索后，应重新评估而不是继续打开每一个剩余容器。
when_to_apply: 在先加热后放置任务的获取阶段，目标物体未立即出现或不在首个检查位置时。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_006 | Failure Lesson]
description: 当加热在物体被手持时成功，物体仍留在持有状态。此后尝试从微波炉取物可能返回 Nothing happens，因为该加热动作并未把物体放入微波炉。
why_it_happens: 手持状态下的加热成功并不一定移动物体进入微波炉，因此微波炉里没有可取的该物体。若按错误位置假设继续操作，就会产生无效取物步骤。
how_to_avoid: 在手持加热成功后，通过库存或手持状态确认物体仍在手中，然后前往目的地。除非物体确实被放入过微波炉，否则不要发出从微波炉取物的动作。
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | T4_007 | Failure Lesson]
description: 在加热与最终目的地之间插入额外台面或其他中间放置，会增加不必要的动作，并可能导致物体跟踪或最终放置失败。
why_it_happens: 任务可能被过度分解，即使目标只要求把加热后的物体移动到最终目的地，也引入了中间放置步骤。中间放置会改变物体位置并增加需要跟踪的状态。
how_to_avoid: 加热后，拿起或保持物体，直接前往最终目的地并在那里放置。只有在环境明确要求中间放置时，才添加此类步骤。
